continuity: The old man is the Helper who first taught Taekyung to circulate qi; his identity beyond that remains unknown.
Taekyung recognized that he perceived the invisible attack through the Mind’s Eye, and the Helper gave him an unidentified final gift before sending him back.
The Helper says the gray-white space will endure and that he remains there by his own choice, awaiting an unknown end.
Taekyung returns to his body, which Jeok Cheongang believes lifeless; a finger moves at the chapter’s end, leaving his condition unresolved.
plot: The old man guides Taekyung to recognize that he perceived qi through the Mind’s Eye. As their meeting ends, Taekyung recognizes the old man as the Helper, who once taught him to circulate qi. The Helper gives him a final gift and sends him back, urging him to save everyone and himself. The Helper remains alone in the gray-white space, which persists; he says he chose to remain there and must wait again.
Jeok Cheongang grieves over Taekyung’s apparently lifeless body. As a tear lands on Taekyung’s hand, a finger submerged in blood moves.
translation_decisions: Render 도우미 as “the Helper” and 심안 as “the Mind’s Eye.”

active_continuity: The Helper is the unknown old man who taught Taekyung to circulate qi and can communicate within his mind.
Taekyung perceived qi through the Mind’s Eye and received an unidentified gift from the Helper.
The Helper remains in the enduring gray-white space by his own choice, waiting for an unknown end.
Taekyung has returned to his body, which appears lifeless to Jeok Cheongang; a submerged finger moved.
open_questions: Who is the Helper beyond the name Taekyung recognizes, and what is his purpose?
What did the Helper give Taekyung?
What is Taekyung’s condition after his finger moved?
What does the Helper’s instruction to save everyone and himself refer to?

names.notes: Taekyung’s name for the mysterious being who first taught him to circulate qi.

profile_creations.personality: He chose to remain in his solitary prison and places his trust in Taekyung.
profile_creations.relationships: He guided Taekyung from the beginning of his time in Murim and gave him an unidentified final gift.
profile_creations.role: A mysterious being who inhabits an enduring gray-white space and first taught Jin Taekyung to circulate qi.
profile_creations.voice: Calm and instructive, he uses reflective questions and concise guidance.

profile_updates.current: - **Relationships:** Jin Mukyung is his older brother, and Jeok Cheongang is his Master and trusted confidant; Hyuk Mujin trusts Taekyung to fight beside him; Taekyung trusts Sama Pyo as a friend despite suspecting his betrayal, and values him beyond his unorthodox affiliation; Peng Cheolhu regarded Taekyung as a worthy successor, and the Bow Saint relayed the Martial God’s message to him.
